author: NASS
description:
I colorized, fully restored, and provided immersive sound design for these rare scenes, which were filmed in the 1940s in Philadelphia, focusing not only on the natural surroundings but also on the unique architectural elements, which sometimes remind one of far-off lands. The scenes show the people engaging in their work, such as farming and going to the markets, before moving on to the scenes of leisure and socialization. The people are shown bowling, hanging out in bars, playing pool and checkers, dancing, going to the movies

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to FHD quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
✔ Full restoration: stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring made with my own AviSynth and VapourSynth scripts

title: Madison, Indiana 1940s in color [60fps, Remastered] Sound Design
